user.title: Dashboard
user.description: Adds the configuration the dashboard app reads. Set it up under Configure once it is added.

init.title: Dashboard
init.description: Choose what to change. Each part saves on its own.

rooms.title: Rooms in the grid
rooms.description: Pick the areas the dashboard shows, and drag them into the order you want. An area left out does not appear at all.

room_edit.title: {area}
room_edit.description: Pick what this room shows, and drag the entities into the order you want.

data.name: Name shown instead of the area's
data.picture: Picture shown instead of the area's
data.hidden: Keep this room behind the More button

data_description.extras: For an entity that belongs to no area, such as one defined in YAML.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the area's own name.
data_description.picture: Leave empty to use the area's own picture.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.description: The things reached for every day. They sit above the room grid on the Overview page, in the order you drag them into.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Which pages the dashboard's sidebar offers. Settings is always shown.

abort.no_rooms: No rooms yet. Pick the areas under Rooms in the grid first.
